title: the shot diet stops standing in for the hub's ROLE — a card that is a big ONLY by is_big's middle shape clause (`rim >= 60 and 3pt < 40`) now has to pass recal_138's own creation-surplus test instead of being handed role 1.00 by recal_55's class, so one rim point can no longer move OFF by three and a half. cost: NO ANCHOR WAS RE-DERIVED AND NO PIN WAS RELEASED. OFF_TOP / DEF_TOP / KNEE are byte-identical (recal_90's warning), is_big is byte-identical, and every one of the 178 anchors passes with the same mean |error| 0.79 the round started from. This round ADDS one anchor: Jimmy Butler '21 off 85 +-3.

recal_138's SENTENCE 'A BIG IS STILL A HUB, unconditionally' IS NO LONGER TRUE OF ONE OF is_big's FOUR BRANCHES, and a later round must not quote it whole. It still holds exactly as written for the POSITION branch (PF/C, never a guard — 168 of the 221 hub-paid bigs) and for shape clauses 1 and 3, which read rimprot. It does NOT hold for the middle shape clause alone: those 26 cards now answer recal_138's own role question. recal_55's class is therefore intact everywhere it was making a claim about a BODY and is measured everywhere it was making a claim about a SHOT.

THE 3PT SEAM AT THE TOP OF THE CLAUSE IS NARROWER BUT NOT CLOSED, and it is honest to say so. Magic '89 (a clause-2 big, role 1.00) still reads four above Magic '90 (not a big, role 0.00 because recal_176's volume ramp starts at 73 and his volume is 69). That gap is recal_176's volume ramp, not this clause, and Magic '90 is a PINNED card at 93 — closing it is a round about PD_V_HI, not about is_big.

THE BIGGEST MOVER IS NOT THE SUBJECT: LeBron James '26 off 87 -> 83, ovr 80 -> 77. A 41-year-old wing at rim 86 / 3pt 38 with a creation surplus of MINUS ONE was taking the whole hub for a shot diet. He is unpinned, and the reading is reported rather than softened.
notes: THE SUBJECT, DECOMPOSED BEFORE ANYTHING WAS CHANGED. Jimmy Butler '21 printed OFF 89 on a weighted sum of 87.351, a paint-evidence floor of +3.439, an elite-passer term of +1.162 and a HUB of +3.510 — 'big (role 1.00 by recal_55's own class)', hub load 70.20 x K 0.05. o_score 95.4614 x 0.93 = 88.78. Without the hub the same card reads 91.9514 x 0.93 = 85.51 = OFF 86. His own '20 season reads a weighted sum of 82.278, so five of the nine points between '20 and '21 are a real sheet and three and a half are the FLAG.

WHICH TERM THE RULING IS ABOUT, and it is not a weight. Butler's rim rating goes 58 / 64 / 63 / 63 / 58 across '20-'24 at 3pt 10-57, which crosses is_big's middle shape clause `rim >= 60 and 3pt < 40` four times; the big flag flips perimeter / big / big / big / perimeter with it, and recal_138's hub role flips 0 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 0. As a PERIMETER card his role would be ramp(playvol 78 - volume 81) = 0.00 — he creates less of the offence than he shoots of it. The number was never a hub's number.

WHY THE CLAUSE AND NOT THE CLASS, stated as recal_93 stated it for the defensive branch. is_big has four ways in. The position branch (PF/C, never a guard) and shape clauses 1 and 3 all read DEFENSIVE bars — rimprot >= 55 and rimprot >= perdef, and rimprot >= 80 — and are claims about a body playing a position. The middle clause reads `rim` and `3pt`, which are o_score's OWN zone ratings: how the man SCORES. recal_93's sentence about the defensive side is the same sentence here — 'how a man SCORES was deciding how he is GRADED' — and recal_138's own comment already conceded the seam on this exact card class: 'the man is identical and the FLAG is the difference'.

THE TEST IS NOT NEW AND NEITHER IS ITS RAMP. A clause-2-only big now takes recal_138's own role measurement, the creation surplus `playvol - volume` ramped over the hub's own width (HUB_FULL - HUB_GATE = 20). Same quantity, same width, same ramp shape recal_93 gave the defensive branch. A man who creates more of the offence than he shoots of it is paid in full — every Magic Johnson season on this clause reads role 1.00 — and a man whose own shot outruns his creation is not.

THE VARIANT THAT WAS MEASURED AND REJECTED. Multiplying recal_154/176's VOLUME ramp into the new branch as well doubles the footprint, 12 movers -> 22, and every one of the ten extra is Magic Johnson: '85 93 -> 85, '84 91 -> 83, '83 89 -> 82, '82 85 -> 79, '88 95 -> 90, '86 98 -> 93, '89 97 -> 93, '87 96 -> 92, '81 79 -> 76, '80 76 -> 73. It flattens the '86 decline round 144 shaped, on a ramp aimed at nobody in this round — and it reaches the subject at the same 86. That ramp exists for one stated reason, disjointness with recal_109's elite-passer band, and a big's exemption from it is recal_55's class, which this round does not reopen.

MEASURED ON THE WHOLE POOL: 12 of 10,000 cards move on OFF, EVERY ONE OF THEM DOWN, mean -1.83, max -4; DEF moves on ZERO, every attribute moves on ZERO, the big flag moves on ZERO; OVR follows on 10, max -3. The top 12 by OFF and the top 12 by OVR are identical and there are ZERO rank flips touching the top 50 by OVR. The tactics harness passes all nine dimensions unswept, so no deviation tax was re-derived.

THE MOVERS ARE ONE ARCHETYPE AND IT IS THE ARCHETYPE THE CLAUSE DESCRIBES: a paint-scoring, non-shooting wing whose own shot outruns his creation. Butler '21/'22/'23, DeRozan '20, LeBron '07 and '26, Pippen '93/'94, Franz Wagner '25, Iguodala '09, Bernard King '91 — and Magic '81, the one card inside the 20-point ramp rather than at either end of it.
